name: Create a program and course
description: Verifies a student can create a program and add a course under that program.
steps: Open Courses and add 'Web Development' under 'Software Engineering'
expected: Software Engineering and Web Development remain visible, and the course shows Software Engineering as its program.

name: Use a course for an assignment and exam
description: Verifies assignments and exams can be linked to an existing course.
steps: Add an assignment named 'PHP Assignment' and select PHP
Add an exam named 'PHP Exam' and select PHP
expected: Both the assignment and exam show PHP as their course.

name: Mark an assignment complete
description: Verifies clicking an assignment check button marks it complete and keeps the completed state after refresh.
steps: Open Assignments and click its check button
expected: The assignment shows a green checkmark, its title is crossed out, and it remains completed after refresh.

name: Reject incomplete program
description: Verifies a program cannot be saved without a name.
expected: A validation message appears and no blank program is created.

name: Show program and course progress
description: Verifies course progress and the number of courses in a program are visible.
steps: Create a course under it with 60 percent progress
expected: The course shows 60 percent progress and the program lists its course count.
